context: src/ contains application code grouped by feature. tests/ mirrors src/. docs/ holds documentation. New source files belong next to the feature they serve, not at the repository root.

rules.name: Application code
checks: Is the new file placed in the feature directory it belongs to?
Is the new file's name consistent with the kebab-case names of its sibling files?

checks.check: Does the new file duplicate an existing module's responsibility?
Is the new file placed at src/ root although it belongs to a feature?

rules.name: Documentation
rules.context: Documentation is written in Japanese and grouped by topic under docs/.
checks: Is the document placed in the directory matching its topic?

checks.check: Does the document overlap with an existing document?
